plain: A fitting match or agreement between things.

webster.text: Suitableness; the relation of agreement between things.

more.text: In school divinity, the good actions which are supposed to render it meet and equitable that God should confer grace on those who perform them.

example.quote: As you, sometimes, swear by him that made you , I conclude, your sentiment does not correspond with his, in that which is the basis of the doctrine, you both agree in; and this makes it impossible to imagine whence this congruity between you arises.
example.cite: Alexander Hamilton, The Farmer Refuted (Feb. 23, 1775) (excerpt, Teaching American History)
